decisions: Keep the portfolio presentation intentionally minimal: white canvas, near-black copy, gray supporting text, light dividers.
Prioritize editor clarity, keyboard access, and content architecture over decorative styling.
Project details use a Dribbble-inspired bottom sheet: 90vw by 90vh, upward slide, strong top shadow, internal scrolling, and no route change.
Portfolio appearance is driven by semantic theme tokens with preset starting points, per-color customization, live preview, and WCAG AA contrast feedback.
Editor navigation and actions use restrained Lucide icons; uploaded images use a top-right X removal control and destructive list actions use compact Remove buttons.
Image path fields use a visibly muted read-only state whenever an image is already set; removing the image unlocks the field for a new path.
Every uploaded image exposes an independent 0-200px corner-radius control, with square as an explicit option and the chosen radius shared anywhere that image is rendered.
Page title and SEO metadata are localized content, while the browser favicon is a shared uploaded asset; active locale changes update document, Open Graph, and Twitter metadata live.
